newsitem.title: USA: Fed seen adding reserves via four-day system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed seen adding reserves via four-day system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve is seen adding temporary reserves to the banking system on Thursday through four-day system repurchase agreements, analysts said.
"We're looking for a four-day system RP," said an economist at Stone and McCarthy Research Associates Inc.
Analysts at consulting firm MMS International Inc also see the Fed adding reserves through term system RPs.
Experts did not rule out the possibility of a permanent add of reserves by the Fed through a coupon pass.
At 0945 EST/1445 GMT, federal funds were traded at 5.25 percent, in line with the Fed's target.
